nodes.name: Digital Art
nodes.description: Art created or presented with digital technology, including new media and interactive forms.

nodes.name: Digital Painting
nodes.description: Painting created with software brushes on a digital canvas.

nodes.name: Digital Illustration
nodes.description: Illustration produced with digital tools.

nodes.name: Pixel Art
nodes.description: Art created by placing individual pixels, rooted in early games.

nodes.name: Vector Art
nodes.description: Art defined by mathematical paths and curves rather than pixels.

nodes.name: Fractal Art
nodes.description: Art generated from the mathematics of fractal geometry.

nodes.name: 3D Modeling
nodes.description: Creating three-dimensional digital objects and scenes.

nodes.name: Digital Sculpture
nodes.description: Sculpting digital forms in virtual three-dimensional space.

nodes.name: Glitch Art
nodes.description: Art exploiting digital errors and corruption as aesthetic.

nodes.name: Projection Mapping
nodes.description: Projecting imagery onto irregular surfaces to transform them.

nodes.name: Photo Manipulation
nodes.description: Altering photographs digitally to create new imagery.

nodes.name: Generative Art
nodes.description: Art created with autonomous systems and algorithms.

nodes.name: Algorithmic Art
nodes.description: Art generated by executing coded algorithms.

nodes.name: Procedural Art
nodes.description: Art generated through rule-based procedures and parameters.

nodes.name: AI-Generated Art
nodes.description: Art produced with machine-learning models such as diffusion and GAN systems.

nodes.name: New Media Art
nodes.description: Art engaging with digital, networked, and interactive technologies.

nodes.name: Interactive Art
nodes.description: Art that responds to audience participation and input.

nodes.name: Net Art
nodes.description: Art made for and distributed through the internet.

nodes.name: Virtual Reality Art
nodes.description: Immersive art experienced in virtual environments.

nodes.name: Augmented Reality Art
nodes.description: Art overlaying digital content onto the physical world.

nodes.name: Bio Art
nodes.description: Art working with living organisms and biotechnology.

nodes.name: Robotic Art
nodes.description: Art incorporating robots and autonomous machines.

nodes.name: Data Visualization Art
nodes.description: Artistic rendering of data as visual form.

nodes.name: Sound Art
nodes.description: Art in which sound is the primary material.

nodes.name: Video Art
nodes.description: Art made with video as its medium, distinct from cinema.

nodes.name: NFT Art
nodes.description: Digital art sold and authenticated via non-fungible tokens.
